en: Sepia-toned group portrait of about forty men, women, and children posed outdoors in front of a plain plastered stone building with a single multi-pane window. Most men wear suits and ties, women wear modest dresses and headscarves or hats. One man in front reclines on the grass holding a guitar, while some hats lie on the ground. The background shows a low stone wall and rough grass, with no visible printed caption on the image side.
